## Definition of Done
- [ ] PR title is a Conventional Commit (drives the squash commit + release)
- [ ] Tests cover the change and the suite is green
- [ ] Lint / static analysis clean
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md updated (or release automation will derive it)
- [ ] Docs updated (`docs/` page and index row for any new public unit; README if the overview moved)
- [ ] Linked to its issue / RFC
